subject: Air freight inquiry – MNL
body:
Hello,

Could you please quote the fastest air freight option to MNL (Manila, PH)? The furniture samples will be ready for pickup at our site in 70839 (Stuttgart), Germany, on 2026-11-26. Please arrange the truck from our site to the departure airport and include it in your all-in price in EUR.

The shipment consists of 10 pieces, with a gross weight of 1155 kg and a total volume of 2.86 cbm. The packing list is attached.

Please attach your offer as a PDF to your reply, as our purchasing department needs it for filing.

Thank you.

Best greetings from Regensburg
Tobias Auer
Versand / Shipping
Auer Maschinenbau GmbH

classification.reasoning: The customer is requesting a new all-in air freight quote for a shipment to Manila.
